description: This file defines the CalendarActivity class used for managing calendar-related activities within SuiteCRM, including constructor logic for handling different activity types, database query helpers for fetching activities within specific timeframes, and methods for retrieving free/busy times and scheduled activities. It also manages access control and integrates with other SuiteCRM modules.

classes.name: CalendarActivity
classes.description: Represents a calendar activity, encapsulating start and end times, associated bean, and methods for querying activities within date ranges. Handles constructor logic for different activity types (tasks, generic activities, free/busy slots) and provides static methods for related queries and retrievals.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a CalendarActivity instance based on the provided arguments, supporting different activity types such as tasks, generic activities, or free/busy slots.

methods.name: get_occurs_within_where_clause
methods.description: Generates a SQL WHERE clause for fetching activities that occur within a specified time range.

methods.name: get_occurs_until_where_clause
methods.description: Generates a SQL WHERE clause for fetching activities until a specified end date.

methods.name: get_freebusy_activities
methods.description: Retrieves free/busy time slots for a user within a specified date range by parsing vCal data.

methods.name: get_activities
methods.description: Fetches a list of activities (calls, meetings, tasks) within a specified time window, applying access control and filtering options.
